inspection: Original PNG bytes fetched by pinned Git object, SHA-256 matched to the source catalogue and visually inspected on 2026-11-21. No original artwork is copied into CyberSand.
image_boundary: These AI-generated concept illustrations are not CyberSand output. Their geometry, materials, collision, routes and physics are not authoritative native labels. Cards preserve observations separately from proposed bounded reconstruction.
rights: Original assets remain in the owner's source repository. This adapter redistributes only authored observations, identifiers, hashes and immutable links; it grants no new artwork licence.

cards.title: Orbital assembly hangar
visible_observations: A large central hall is framed by tall vertical columns and a continuous roof truss.
A horizontal overhead crane crosses the upper hall, with a suspended hook above an elongated fuselage on several supports.
Side rooms and galleries have ladders and short stairs; the lower service level is visually separate from the assembly floor.
The central volume is relatively open; dense conduits, control panels and railings concentrate around boundaries and machinery.
native_proposal: Use a bounded orthographic frame with two strong side supports, a roof beam and short attached galleries.
Reserve a continuous clear floor corridor between the supports; use repeated rectangular brackets and fixtures around the perimeter.
Treat crane and fuselage details as optional static shape motifs, not functioning equipment or physics claims.
uncertainties: Pixel art depth and windows do not specify collision planes.
Visible apparent metal does not determine a CyberSand material ID.
Ladders and stairs suggest traversal but do not prove a native actor can traverse.

cards.title: Mycological chasm
visible_observations: A tall open chasm and central waterfall separate irregular terraced rock ledges.
Short diagonal steps connect some adjacent terraces; wooden-looking ladders connect other vertical levels.
Large purple mushroom caps and branching roots create distinct silhouettes around the void.
Small fungi and hanging growth follow the ledge surfaces rather than filling the open centre.
native_proposal: Translate the terrace-following branching rhythm into a connected orthogonal service-pipe spine and bounded risers.
Keep a declared clear inspection corridor below the pipe branches and cap endpoints visibly.
This pipework analogy is an inferred construction exercise; it does not claim pipes are present in the source image or simulate its waterfall.
uncertainties: Decorative roots are not labelled native support geometry.
Waterfall appearance supplies no Water solver or volume parameters.
The prototype studies routing relationships, not pixel-perfect geological reconstruction.

cards.title: Containment-tree arboretum
visible_observations: A large luminous organic pod and branching root silhouette occupy the open middle of an underground research bay.
Rectangular laboratories are embedded into both rock walls; the right upper room contains a row of specimen vessels.
A continuous middle walkway crosses the bay above a separate lower service corridor.
Railings, wall monitors, lift machinery, conduits and small boxes gather around room and walkway edges.
native_proposal: Place compact service-panel banks and repeated surface details along side walls, preserving the central negative space.
Use deliberate repeated brackets, ventilation slits and connector motifs instead of unstructured noise.
Keep luminous organisms and laboratory vessels as visual reference only; this greeble exercise does not invent material reactions or functional actors.
uncertainties: Green lighting does not identify native organic materials.
Specimen vessels and displays are artwork, not existing equipment definitions.
The source suggests a walkable layout but does not prove physical traversability.
